adjudication.rationale: In app/views/embed/loading.html.erb, the only behavior is a `setTimeout` that calls `document.location.reload();` every 30000ms with no max retry or fallback UI. If the background job never succeeds (e.g., network error, invalid URL, or other failure in `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` / retrieval), the iframe will keep reloading indefinitely, causing a poor UX and unnecessary repeated requests.
